senses.gloss: m. (καθολικός) financial officer, controller, esp. catholicos, an officer of the Temple treasury.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 37">Ex. R. s. 37</cite>, beg. <he>למלך … ק׳ ומנהו וכ׳</he> like a king that had a friend, and when he wanted to appoint a controller, he appointed him over his entire treasury; Y’lamd. to Gen. XLIX, 1 quot. in Ar. <cite ref="S02287"><he>קתוליכוס</he></cite> (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 18:12">Num. R. s. 18</cite> <he>קרח שהיה ק׳ וכ׳</he> Korah who was the controller of Pharaoh’s palace and had in charge the keys &c. Y. Shek. V, 49ᵃ <he>קתיליקוס</he>, <cite ref="S02290"><he>קתיליקון</he></cite>, <he>קתיליקיס</he> (Bab. ed. <he>קתליקין</he>, <he>קתליקין</he>; corr. acc.); a. e.—Pl. <he>קָתוֹלִיקִין</he>. Ib. <he>אין פיחתין משני ק׳</he> (Bab. ed. a. ed. Zyt. <he>כתל׳</he>, corr. acc.) there were never less than two catholici in the Temple treasury.—

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:9">Cant. R. to VII, 9</cite> (expl. <cite ref="Q00458"><he>פחותא</he></cite>, <cite ref="Daniel 3:2">Dan. III, 2</cite>) <cite ref="S02281"><he>קתאליקי</he></cite> (some ed. <he>קאת׳</he>), read <he>קָתוֹלִיקֵי</he> or <he>קָאת׳</he> (ch. pl.) controllers.
